hookups.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('Camping is primitive, temporary and dispersed. There are no established campsites and no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations).'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' Hidden Valley lists Primitive Camping among its activities; its only named facility is 'a boat launching ramp and parking on the north side of Hidden Valley Lake, accessible through Low Gap from Route 690', and its page names no camping spot.

booking.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ + https://dwr.virginia.gov/wma/hidden-valley/ (Recreational Opportunities: 'Primitive Camping'; Facilities: 'There is a boat launching ramp and parking on the north side of Hidden Valley Lake'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DWR's Hidden Valley page that primitive camping is still allowed, and from DWR's statewide camping page: no hookups, no water/dump/restrooms, 14-night limit, $10 camping authorization. Not stated: season, a camping-specific spot on this WMA. Note left as is (AWH firsthand; the DWR fee line says what the inherited all-in rate cannot).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is lakefront and AWH's note says "Two parking/camping areas right on the lakefront", but DWR's statewide rule (https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/) says "It is unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility (building, boat ramp, etc.)". A legal campsite here cannot be on the lake.

Criteria lead (same question as asks #8): the only parking DWR's Hidden Valley page names is the boat-ramp lot on the north side of the lake ("a boat launching ramp and parking on the north side of Hidden Valley Lake"). If AWH's lakefront parking/camping areas are that lot, camping there is unlawful under the 300-ft rule.
Aggregator link in website: https://thedyrt.com/camping/virginia/hidden-valley-wma sits beside the DWR page; the DWR page alone is the official one.
